title: Auftrag
description: A meter-change work order. Shared contract between freitag-webapp (source of truth in Postgres), disposition-web-app (offline-synced subset), and serviceportal (customer-facing view).

id.description: Stable identifier. UUID v4 in freitag-webapp, string in disposition-web-app.

idfNr.description: External IDF number (network operator reference, used in serviceportal lookup).

lat.description: Latitude. Postgres-Drizzle stores as decimal-string; numeric clients accept both.

lon.description: Longitude. Same shape constraint as lat.

zaehlerNummer.description: Meter number. Canonical naming: camelCase with German umlaut transliteration (ae). disposition-web-app legacy field 'zaehlerNr' maps here; freitag-webapp legacy 'zahlernummer' maps here.

kundenname.description: Customer name. disposition-web-app uses 'kundenname'; freitag-webapp uses 'verbrauchername'. Choose one canonical name.

sperrzeitraumVon.description: Period during which the meter must not be changed (start). Only used by freitag-webapp scheduling.

wechseldatum.description: Actual completion date (set when status transitions to 'abgeschlossen').

wechselzeitVon.description: Planned time window start, format HH:MM (e.g. '07:00').
